editorial.name: Origin Financial
editorial.descriptionZh: Origin 把记账、投资、报税和遗产规划收进一个订阅里，用 AI 财务顾问主动挑出能省钱的动作。首页是一整屏实拍天空，上面压衬线斜体大字。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把「帮你省下 3457 美元」当成首屏第二个标题
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是铺满的深蓝天空实拍，左上一枚写着 $99 $1 FOR 1 YEAR LIMITED TIME 的促销胶囊，导航只有 PRODUCTS / FOR EMPLOYERS / RESOURCES / LOG IN / GET STARTED 五项。主标题 Meet your proactive AI Financial Advisor. 用衬线字，其中 proactive 是斜体，下面接 Track all of your finances while Origin proactively finds new ways to save you money. 与一颗白底 GET STARTED。首屏下半是一只手机框，框里写 We found 14 actions that can save you $3,457。往下是四张建议卡，标签分别是 SAVINGS（You have $23,400 in savings earning almost nothing (~0.01%)）、CREDIT、RETIREMENT（Grow your HSA to $180K）、TAX STRATEGY（Put $7,500 of your childcare spending through a dependent care FSA），每条都带一个具体美元数。导航产品线切成 Spending / Investing / Forecasting / Estate Planning / Couples / Taxes 六块，页脚标题是 Download Origin。
editorial.pricing: Paid：首屏促销为 $99 一年 $1（limited time），属订阅制会员

reasons.statement: 首屏交付的是 Origin 自己的产品卖点、省钱示例卡与下载入口，用户拿走的是天空实拍配衬线斜体这一套排版，拿不到任何可复用素材；来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感池，故归产品与公司官网。
导航按产品线分成 /products/spending、/products/investing、/products/forecasting、/products/estate-planning、/couples、/products/taxes 六条，另有 /employers，是产品门面站。
